item.title: Tekcapital’s Guident signs three-year robotics deal with Coastal Waste
item.summary: It’s been a busy week of announcements for Tekcapital, with Friday bringing an update on portfolio company Guident, which has signed a 36-month agreement with Coastal Waste & Recycling. It’s an extension of an existing deal that will see the rollout of autonomous inspection robots and AI monitoring software across the operator’s US sites.
